hero.name: Fikrie, Fahreza
hero.headline: Building Quality.
hero.bio: Originally from Jakarta, Indonesia, now calling Melbourne home for over 20 years. I ensure software excellence while being a proud husband and father.

about.intro: I'm a dedicated Quality Engineer with a passion for delivering flawless software experiences. My journey started in Jakarta, but for over two decades, Melbourne has been my home. When I'm not ensuring software quality, I'm spending time with my beautiful wife Mira and our two boys, Rafael and Mikhail.

contact.intro: Whether you have a project in mind or just want to chat about quality engineering, I'd love to hear from you.
